summary: Picross Vol entries from Sami's spine and sourced supplemental seeds, built for per-platform route research.

entries.title: Picross Vol 1 ~ 8
entries.definitive_edition: Picross NP Vol. 1-8 original Nintendo Power releases

emulation.notes: Treat the eight volumes as one archival set; preserve each volume separately because their Nintendo-franchise puzzle themes differ.

primary.version: Picross NP Vol. 1-8 on SF Memory Cassette
primary.why: The Picross NP volumes were Japan-only Super Famicom Nintendo Power service releases, with Jupiter releasing Vol. 1 through Vol. 8 as rewritable Nintendo Power cartridge software. No modern official collection is known.
primary.how_to_play: Use a dumped SF Memory Cassette copy or accurate Super Famicom emulation for each of Picross NP Vol. 1 through Vol. 8. Original Nintendo Power cartridge hardware is the preservation-authentic route if available.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern official remaster or compilation of the Picross NP volumes exists.
